newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain on defensive.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain on defensive.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were steady to weaker Thursday in quiet conditions, weighed down by sluggish demand and a modest pickup in flour mill run-times, dealers said.
"Run-times are up, demand is down," one dealer said.
Prices in Kansas City were around $1.00 lower with bids at $91.00 and offers at $93.00. The market has tumbled about $11.00 since the end of last week.
At some locations, such as North Texas, offers were nominally steady but dealers said there was no buying interest and if the market traded it would be at lower levels.
Dealers said demand for millfeeds was often subdued in late January and early February but were hopeful buying interest may pick up later in the month.
